Which shortwave stations broadcast in Russian?

In the A-26 schedule, 24 stations broadcast in Russian. The most heavily scheduled include China Radio International, HCJB Voice of Andes, Radio Exterior España, Voice of Korea.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Russian?

The most-used frequencies are 9820, 15665, 3995, 5920, 5990 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
